verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bolna ships an MCP *server* so external clients like Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf can control a Bolna account (bolna-docs-17, bolna-probe-3) — this is the reverse direction from the story, which asks whether Bolna's own agents can plug in external MCP servers to gain their tools. No evidence describes Bolna voice agents consuming or calling external MCP servers.
